hooks.command: S=.claude/session-summary.md; [ -s "$S" ] || exit 0; LAST=$(git log -1 --format='%ct %s' -g refs/stash 2>/dev/null); NOW=$(date +%s); LAST_T=${LAST%% *}; LAST_M=${LAST#* }; if [ -n "$LAST_T" ] && [ $((NOW - LAST_T)) -lt 60 ] && [ "${LAST_M#*session-end}" != "$LAST_M" ]; then exit 0; fi; T=$(head -1 "$S"); D=$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M); git stash push -u -m "[session-end $D] $T" >/dev/null 2>&1 && git stash apply --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
